start_s.description: Inclusive speech-segment start in seconds from the input start.

end_s.description: Exclusive speech-segment end in seconds from the input start; must exceed start_s.

confidence.description: Peak speech probability within this accepted segment.

title: VadResponse
description: Normalized voice-activity result. Segments must be ordered and non-overlapping; the model client enforces all cross-field invariants.

speech.description: True exactly when segments is non-empty.

probability.description: Maximum segment confidence, or 0.0 when segments is empty.

segments.description: Accepted speech regions in ascending, non-overlapping time order.
